newsitem.title: USA: Truimph says gets $85 million credit line.
newsitem.headline: Truimph says gets $85 million credit line.

text.p: Triumph Group Inc said Tuesday it entered into an amended five year agreement for a $85 million line of credit with PNC Bank, Mellon Bank and First Union Bank.

Triumph said the new agreement gives it added lending capacity for both its short-term needs and to support an aggressive acquisition program. The company was not immediately able to provide details of that aquisition program.
Truimph said PNC Bank holds $60 million of the line of credit, with First Union lending $15 million and Mellon lending $10 million.
Triumph Group Inc designs and manufactures aircraft components.
